basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old software developer from Barcelona, Spain, currently exploring various aspects of self-improvement and mental well-being. I have a keen interest in anime and am always on the lookout for new recommendations. My work involves creating apps, so I often find myself on patentlaw to keep up with the latest in tech and legalities. In my free time, I love diving into historical mysteries, especially anything related to JFK. I'm single and usually online during the late night hours, as I find that’s when I'm most productive. I dislike negativity and prefer communities that are supportive and positive.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from a local university in Barcelona. My programming skills are mostly self-taught, driven by personal projects and curiosity. My interest in history and law is more of a hobby, fueled by online courses and community discussions.
